test_title: PYST 34: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 6 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank**

You _____ told me that you are planning to take up a course in photography and now you are denying it.
solution:
The correct answer is **'yourself'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Intensive pronouns are reflexive pronouns
